evidence.1: This also marked the first time the ceremony was organised outside France or Switzerland.

one_source.claim: Harry Kane became the fifth Englishman to win the Men's Ballon d'Or

evidence.1: He became the fifth Englishman to win the award, with the latest before him being Michael Owen in 2001.

one_source.claim: Alexia Putellas became the sixth consecutive Spaniard to win the Women's Ballon d'Or

evidence.1: She became the sixth consecutive Spaniard to win the award, with the latest before her being Aitana Bonmati in 2025.

one_source.claim: The 2026 Ballon d'Or was the 70th annual ceremony

evidence.1: The 2026 Ballon d'Or (lit. '2026 Golden Ball') was the 70th annual ceremony of the Ballon d'Or, presented by France Football, recognising the best footballers
